title: Market traders recovery
summary: Independent review, verified relief, compensation assessment and replacement trading spaces.

title: Taxation and business relief
summary: Review duplicative levies and introduce a 12-month relief programme for eligible registered micro and small businesses.

title: Land and housing
summary: Review land charges and urban designations, protect customary land rights and expand affordable housing.

title: Agriculture and ranching
summary: Three-zone agricultural clusters, local processing, storage and the decentralised Odalije Ranching Model.

title: Coal, gas and mineral development
summary: Pursue regulated partnerships for resource development, local mineral processing and industrial power.

title: Steady Power
summary: Proposed solar systems, battery storage and community mini-grids for markets, rural communities and public services.

title: ICT and digital economy
summary: Digital skills, technology entrepreneurship, remote employment and creative-economy development.

title: Tourism and cultural heritage
summary: Develop natural attractions, heritage sites and locally beneficial tourism investment.

title: International airport
summary: Pursue passenger, cargo and diaspora connectivity through commercially viable aviation partnerships.

title: Fiscal accountability
summary: Public financial reporting, auditing and transparent oversight of public resources.

title: Local government autonomy
summary: Direct local council funding and greater responsibility for community-level delivery.

title: Legislative independence
summary: Restore legislative autonomy and strengthen oversight functions.

title: Judiciary and rule of law
summary: Judicial financial autonomy, court modernisation and accessible justice.

title: State-wide security
summary: An intelligence-driven, community-supported security network focused on prevention and response.

title: Workers and retirees
summary: Verify outstanding gratuities, provide predictable payments and prevent new backlogs.

title: Community leadership
summary: Strengthen the welfare and development roles of traditional institutions and faith-based partners.

title: Healthcare
summary: Upgrade primary health centres and hospitals, expand coverage and strengthen preventive care.

title: Education
summary: Assess existing schools, improve teaching quality, rehabilitate infrastructure and expand practical learning.

title: Water for All
summary: 24-month solar-for-water programme, reservoir rehabilitation, pipe expansion and rural water kiosks.

title: Environment and sanitation
summary: Address erosion, flooding and waste management to protect communities.

title: Youth, skills and sports
summary: Vocational training, entrepreneurship, talent development and sports opportunities.

title: Women and vulnerable residents
summary: Economic empowerment, protection of widows and accessible services for persons with disabilities.

title: Rural Rescue Compact
summary: Ten commitments covering direct council funding, water, clinics, roads, power, security and land protection.
